positioning: cross-family and workflow-composition generalisation: whole workflow families are held out, but sub-workflows (e.g. authorise a change, move a problem to root cause, map them) recur across splits in new combinations; a write-tool Jaccard below the family threshold is not by itself evidence of no near-duplicate (see family_audit.json cross_split_shared_subworkflows)
usage: train: optimisation; dev: debugging and budget/length checks only, not checkpoint selection (12 of 13 dev tasks are one workflow); checkpoints follow a training-step count and rule fixed in advance, at the latest in step 8; heldout: final frozen evaluation only, never for debugging, tuning or checkpoint selection

method.base: split v1 kept: the 53 Bench2 tasks keep their v1 split, dev and heldout are identical to v1; the three EnterpriseOps-Gym-derived tasks accepted on 2026-10-30 are added to train; the assignment is not re-optimised
method.family_rule: as v1: link two tasks if the Jaccard similarity of their gold write-tool sets >= 0.6 or they share a creation tool; families are the connected components over all 56 tasks; a v1 family name is kept only for a family whose members are exactly its v1 members, other families get a v2 label
method.business_type_rule: per task: Bench2 tasks keep their v1 business type, derived tasks are curated by their primary request; a family lists its members' types
